page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s6-c1m2.large is an entry-level virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s6 server family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance features 2 virtual CPUs mapped to 2 physical cores with 1 thread per core. It is configured with a shared CPU allocation model, meaning CPU resources are shared with other tenants on the host hardware.

This instance is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include any bundled local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. There are no integrated graphics processing units on this instance. The baseline network bandwidth is rated at 0 Gbps, indicating it is designed for low-throughput networking environments.

Due to its shared CPU allocation and modest memory footprint, the ecs.s6-c1m2.large offers a highly cost-efficient profile for non-critical workloads. The shared resource model reduces overhead, making it suitable for budget-conscious deployments. It is best suited for lightweight applications, development and testing environments, low-traffic web servers, and basic microservices that do not require sustained high CPU performance or dedicated hardware resources.
